title: On Sun's Conjectures for Truncated Jacobi-Symbol Determinants via Supersingular Elliptic Curves
summary: We study the truncated Jacobi-symbol determinants $$\{c,d\}_n=\det\!\left[\left(\frac{j^2+cjk+dk^2}{n}\right)\right]_{2\le j,k\le n-2}$$ proposed by Zhi-Wei Sun in \cite{ZWSun} and prove Conjectures 5.1(i), 5.2, 5.3, 5.4, 5.5, 5.6(i), 5.7, 5.8, a case of 5.6(ii) of \cite{ZWSun}, Conjecture 4.8(i) of \cite{Sun2019} and some strengthened forms. All results follow from a single unified approach: for a prime $p$, we diagonalize the nonzero-residue matrix indexed by $\mathbb{F}_p^\times$ and reduce the vanishing of determinants to the supersingular reduction of certain CM elliptic curves.
